updateTime.description: Date and time when this Sentinel-5P completeness document was last updated

key.description: Unique document key built from the datatake identifier and product type

absolute_orbit.description: Absolute orbit number this completeness applies to

mission.description: Mission identifier derived from the satellite unit (S5)

satellite_unit.description: Satellite unit this completeness applies to (e.g. S5P)

datatake_id.description: Identifier of the datatake this completeness is computed for

observation_time_start.description: Start of the observation period covered by this completeness

observation_time_stop.description: Stop of the observation period covered by this completeness

observation_duration.description: Duration of the observation period in microseconds

timeliness.description: Timeliness of the products this completeness applies to (e.g. NRTI, OFFL, OPER)

product_type.description: Product type this completeness applies to

product_level.description: Product level of the product type (e.g. L0_, L1B, L2_)

value.description: Measured sensing completeness value, total sensing of the produced products in microseconds

expected.description: Expected sensing value for the product type, in microseconds, including tolerance

value_adjusted.description: Sensing completeness value capped at the expected value to avoid percentages above 100%

percentage.description: Completeness percentage of adjusted sensing value over expected value

status.description: Completeness status label derived from the percentage

slice_value.description: Number of product slices produced for this completeness

slice_expected.description: Expected number of product slices for this product type

cams_tickets.description: List of CAMS ticket identifiers linked to this completeness

last_attached_ticket.description: Identifier of the most recently attached CAMS ticket

last_attached_ticket_url.description: URL of the most recently attached CAMS ticket

cams_origin.description: Origin of the last attached CAMS ticket

cams_description.description: Description of the last attached CAMS ticket
